expected.subject: dev.product_feedback/publication-audit-2026-09-07
expected.value: Agent-customer finding: after the larger discovery/acceptance changes, local acceptance time is spread across Git execution, verification, database construction and advisory publication. Treat process elapsed time as work to investigate, not automatically wasted spawn overhead. The flat frozen database digest still requires visiting all logical rows; incremental edits need either exact compatible streaming or a separately governed future digest shape, not arithmetic patching of SHA-256. Eliminating a second verification export needs a trustworthy build-to-bind handoff. Returning before workspace advertisement finishes can remove a visible block but changes when review refs/notes are ready; do not silently call this a transparent optimization. Recommendation: pause this performance pass rather than expanding v1 scope for another small local gain, keep measured scalability tasks, and return to product loops. No production code changed in this audit and no priorities were adopted for the maintainer.
